I designed and built this mobile-responsive portfolio website with Quarto and Bootstrap CSS, which automatically deploys to GitHub Pages and Netlify via GitHub CI/CD Workflows, featuring:

- Custom functionality added with JavaScript and Lua.
- Local deployment fallbacks via Justfile in Rust.
- Custom themes and styling using Bootstrap.
